title: Names for the co-op mode
instruction: Propose names for Ember Hollow's new two-player co-op mode in docs/naming.md. List exactly 5 candidates, one per line in the form `- **Name** — one-line rationale`; each name at most 14 characters and different from every existing mode name in data/modes.json. Mark the one you recommend by appending (recommended) to its line.
